Changelog

Everything that ships to nanoodle, newest first — the same entries as the in-app 📣 Updates panel. Last update: 2 September 2026.

Follow via Atom feed Source on GitHub

2 September 2026

  • New gallery example: Fable cold-open — Keelung harbor switchboard seed (calls arrive as smells; tonight one doesn't), Claude Fable 5.1 writes a 180-word present-tense scene. First-click, no upload, ~$0.02.
  • Spicy H3 is Image→Video only — the gallery example is SFW fashion on those weights. NSFW-only or an exact id surfaces it in the picker; Text→Video will not list it.
  • A spicy id in the SFW picker now shows an NSFW badge — and a tip if you pasted it on Text→Video.
  • Photo → video still prompt fixed — Muse now paints a woman standing on a wet Tokyo fire-escape landing (shallow puddles, profile face), then MiniMax H3 Spicy animates the silk gust (SFW fashion, 480p).
  • Gallery first-click punch (round 2) — fox-masked Tokyo underpass heist (text→image), chrome praying-mantis DJ arena, underground dumpling cartel ops mockup. Still Run with no uploads.
  • Photo → video gallery example now pins MiniMax H3 Spicy — Muse paints a red silk dress on a rainy Tokyo fire escape, then open-weights H3 Spicy animates the gust (SFW fashion, 480p).
  • Pasting a spicy model id in the picker finds it with NSFW off — the default list stays SFW.
  • Gallery first-click examples got a punch — rainy neon courier avatar, receipt-joke custom echo, invoices crime-scene Fable dump, richer Raohe postcard (squid smoke, 3:2).
  • Custom endpoint gallery example first-click Runs against a public HTTPS echo (json mode, no local server, $0). Swap to chat + http://127.0.0.1:8787/v1/chat/completions for the guide's localhost mock.
  • Examples gallery now has a Fable 5-step plan — paste a messy coding dump and Claude Fable 5.1 returns a clean five-step plan (~$0.02/run, first-click).
  • Talking avatar gallery example now first-click Runs — Muse paints a starter face, Minimax Speech speaks your line, Longcat lipsyncs at 480p (no upload). Night-market postcard GLM gets a larger completion budget so the film-stock prompt lands in the answer text.
  • Night-market postcard gallery example now pins Muse Image at 3:2 with a film-stock landscape prompt (was 1:1).
  • Favicon example now ships a filled Lumen sample so Run works on first click; FIBO studio still pins 3:2 editorial aspect instead of a square.
  • Balance chip now ticks live as each paid Play step lands — remaining credit, a brief −$delta, and this session's spend, with + still one click away.
  • Sing example now uses Mureka Generate Song — it already writes lyrics, so Prompt-to-Song is the wrong model.
  • Mureka Prompt-to-Song now sends the track description as prompt (not input), so a wired style/prompt actually generates; a failed music job now shows NanoGPT's status error.
  • Generate Song now asks for Lyrics before sending — no more opaque 400. A lyrics wire (Sing example) counts; empty Lyrics still means use Generate BGM or Prompt-to-Song.
  • Play no longer posts leftover resolution when the catalog doesn't list it — Gemini Omni Flash v1 won't inherit v1.1's 720p/4K.
  • Examples gallery now has an Omni Flash turntable — 8s Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 product clip of a hand-blown amber glass decanter on walnut.
  • New LLM model: Qwen3.8 Max 0902 — This September checkpoint of Qwen's flagship model is built for coding, knowledge work, data analysis, and long-running agent workflows, with multimodal input, selectable thinking, tool calling, structured output,…
  • New video model: MiniMax H3 Spicy Image-to-Video — Animate a reference image with expressive, unrestricted motion and native stereo audio, or guide the transition toward an optional final frame for more controlled cinematic clips.
  • New LLM models: Qwen 3.6 35B A3B Uncensored & Ornith 1.5 9B — Qwen 3.6 35B A3B Uncensored, its Thinking variant, Ornith 1.5 9B, its Thinking variant, and Qwen3 Embedding 8B are temporarily unavailable while the provider moves this infrastructure to a new datacenter.
  • New LLM models: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 & GLM 5.2 & GLM 5.3 & GLM 5.3 Flash & Kimi K3 & Qwen 3.6 35B A3B & Qwen3.8 27B — EngyAI is now available as an opt-in provider for DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731, GLM 5.2, GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, Kimi K3, Qwen 3.6 35B A3B, and Qwen3.8 27B, including thinking variants where applicable.
  • New LLM model: Gemini 3.8 Flash — Google calls it its most intelligent Flash model, combining Flash-class speed and cost efficiency with stronger long-horizon software engineering, autonomous-agent, and enterprise-workflow performance.

1 September 2026

  • FIBO Generate 1.5 Image node now has an aspect-ratio control (1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9). Size stays 1mp or 4mp — shape is a separate knob.
  • Custom endpoint — a failed localhost fetch now names CORS vs Chrome local-network permission, instead of a generic network error.
  • New video model: Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 — Create videos from text, animate a first image with an optional end frame, pin subjects with reference images, or edit an existing clip. 360p–4K, with native audio in the file.
  • Examples gallery now has a FIBO 1.5 studio still — commercially safe product shot on licensed-data Bria FIBO Generate 1.5.
  • New LLM model: IBM Granite 4.2 8B — IBM Granite 4.2 8B is now included in the NanoGPT subscription.
  • New image model: Bria FIBO Generate 1.5 — Bria compressed generation from 50 inference steps to 6 while improving realism and texture quality, making the model a faster option for polished, commercially safe image creation.
  • New audio models: Generate BGM & Generate Song & Prompt-to-Song — Generate BGM creates instrumental background music from a description, Generate Song turns your lyrics into a complete song, and Prompt-to-Song creates the lyrics, vocals, melody, and arrangement from a high-level…
  • New video model: Kling O3 4K — Kling O3 4K can now edit existing videos with natural-language instructions or use a reference video's motion, composition, and camera language to generate a new 4K scene.
  • New LLM model: Mercury 2.5 Preview — Mercury 2.5 Preview is now available and temporarily included in your NanoGPT subscription!
  • New LLM model: Claude Fable 5.1 — It improves on Fable 5 across the board, with the biggest gains in agentic coding, long-running workflows, and knowledge work.

31 August 2026

  • Switch a node's model and any size, duration, or similar knob the new model doesn't offer snaps to a valid choice — no leftover 8s on a 5s/10s list.
  • New LLM model: GLM 5.3 TEE — This private TEE deployment brings GLM 5.3's long-horizon coding, autonomous agent workflows, tool use, vulnerability research, and complex engineering capabilities to confidential inference with attestation support.
  • New LLM models: Qwen3.8 27B & Qwen3.8 27B Thinking — Heabsy is now available as an opt-in provider for Qwen3.8 27B and Qwen3.8 27B Thinking.
  • New LLM model: Abliterated Model Large V2 — Based on GLM-5.3, this uncensored text model is built for harder reasoning, evaluation workloads, long documents, and demanding conversations with a one-million-token context window.
  • Updated: GLM Latest — GLM Latest now points to GLM 5.3 Thinking, so the Latest alias automatically uses the newest GLM reasoning model. GLM Latest is included in the NanoGPT subscription at 2x included-input usage.
  • New LLM model: IBM Granite 4.2 8B — IBM built this compact open model for agents that need to reason, act, and adapt across real-world workflows.

27 August 2026

  • Play on a sibling stays enabled while a shared upstream is still running — it joins that in-flight result instead of waiting or paying twice.
  • Play a branch without locking its siblings — A→B and A→C can run at the same time, and a finished upstream is reused (not billed twice). Input nodes (text, uploads, choice, notes) no longer show a Play button.
  • Custom endpoint node — call a NanoGPT-shaped URL from a graph (typically localhost). The node shows the live request/response contract; the browser fetches that URL directly and never sends your NanoGPT key.
  • Examples gallery now pins August 2026 NanoGPT models (Muse Image, Krea 2 Turbo, Grok Imagine 2.0, Recraft V4 Style, MiniMax Hailuo 3, Music 3, Qwen Image 3 Pro, GLM 5.3 Flash) and adds the night-market postcard starter.
  • New LLM models: Gemma 4 26B A4B Uncensored TEE & standard Gemma 4 26B A4B Uncensored model — Image input for Gemma 4 26B A4B Uncensored TEE has been temporarily disabled because its private deployment is not handling visual prompts reliably. Text prompts remain available.
  • New image model: Muse Image — Meta's image model combines high-fidelity text-to-image generation and precise image editing in one model.
  • New video model: MiniMax H3 Max — Create videos from a text prompt, animate a starting image, or guide a controlled transition with optional first and last frames.
  • New image models: Recraft V4 Style & Recraft V4 Style Pro — Recraft V4 Style and Recraft V4 Style Pro are now available for consistent visual production.
  • New LLM model: GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored — GLM 5.3 Flash Uncensored is now available and included in the NanoGPT subscription at 1x included-input usage!
  • New video model: Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 — Create videos from text, animate a first image with an optional end frame, combine image and video references to preserve subjects and visual style, or edit an existing video with natural-language instructions.

Very long clips still get a clear heads-up (with a ✂️ Trim tip) only when a model's size limit is actually hit.
